source: Nigeria Tax Act, 2025 (Act No. 7 of 2025, commencement 1 January 2026), gazette copy read 2026-11-05 (https://ait.live/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Final-Approved-Copy-for-Print-NIGERIA-TAX-ACT-2025.pdf). Fourth Schedule under section 58: first 800,000 at 0%, next 2,200,000 at 15%, next 9,000,000 at 18%, next 13,000,000 at 21%, next 25,000,000 at 23%, above 50,000,000 at 25%. These apply to income after the eligible deductions of section 30(2): National Housing Fund, National Health Insurance Scheme and Pension Reform Act contributions, interest on a loan for an owner-occupied home, life insurance premiums, and rent relief (20% of annual rent, at most 500,000, when the rent is declared). Pass taxable pay after those deductions; none are applied inside the pack. The copy is a third-party host of the gazette, not nass.gov.ng or the Nigeria Revenue Service.
